pages.title: Fuel for Yesterday
pages.text: Dried peat supplies another smelting run and archstone bricks help furnish an expedition base.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find peat in Paleogene/Neogene, form a pie and collect it after native drying. Smelt Bituminous Rock for powder. Platypodium seed pods in Neogene grow small trees; native leaves may not decay.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Apply Sap to a gravity-affected block. The installed advancement recognizes this sticky-block interaction.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Mine peat in Paleogene/Neogene, craft a peat pie, place it for roughly 20 minutes and collect the dried peat pie. Fuel usable in furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Harvest Platypodium seed pods in the Neogene and place them on ground. Small trees provide convenient wood farming despite non-decaying native leaves.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Process Bituminous Rock using its installed smelting recipe. The powder becomes an input for other recipes.
